rationale: The proposed topology adds a source inductor to improve input matching and noise figure by enhancing the input impedance transformation, which is critical for achieving the tight NF ≤ 2.0 target. The existing circuit suffers from poor input impedance matching (S11 margin is positive but close to limit) and a severely degraded noise figure (over 26 dB), indicating excessive input noise and poor impedance transformation. By adding a source inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source, the input impedance is better tuned toward 50Ω, reducing reflection and improving the effective transconductance-to-noise ratio, which directly improves NF and S21. The inductor also enables better trade-off between gain and noise, crucial for the 1.58 GHz GPS L1 band. The addition is minimal and maintains the single-stage structure, preserving stability and low power.
